title: [clinic · EX-07] Chunking bake-off on your own corpus
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-07` — Chunking bake-off on your own corpus](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-07-chunking-bake-off-on-your-own-corpus.md) · difficulty 🟡

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Comparing strategies at different chunk counts. Fewer, larger chunks change the `k` budget's meaning, so the comparison is not like for like.

**2.** Documents too short for the strategies to differ — the finding in [#5](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/issues/5). If every strategy scores identically, check document length before believing it.

**3.** Reporting the winner without an interval. On this corpus most chunking deltas are inside the band.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-07]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
